segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good morning, this is Rahul from Kosha General Insurance. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Am I speaking with Mister Mehta?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am calling about the renewal of your car insurance policy, which expires on the fifteenth.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Right, I wanted to renew it. Actually my wife also bought a second car last month, a small hatchback.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Okay. So for your policy, the renewal premium is eleven thousand four hundred rupees.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, I will send you a payment link by message.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Also my son just got his driving licence and he will use the car sometimes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Noted. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No, that is all. Thank you.
